definition: someone who entertains an audience on stage
description: In a small tavern with white walls, old posters and hams hanging from a beam, a male flamenco dancer with long dark hair, a short black jacket, black trousers and heeled boots dances on a wooden stage under a spotlight. He stamps his boot so that dust flies up from the boards, then turns, swings his arms and spins with one arm raised high. A guitarist plays behind him, and the audience at small round tables with candles and wine glasses claps and cheers with open mouths.

taps.phrase: to stamp on the dusty stage

de.answer: Er stampft auf der staubigen Bühne.
